help.title: About product variants
help.overview: A variant is one version of a Variable product, such as Red / XL. Each variant has its own stock and can have its own price.

sections.title: Each variant
items: Pick the product, then the options that make the variant, such as Color: Red and Size: XL. Two variants of a product can't have the same options, and the product can't be changed later.
Without its own price, a variant sells at the product's price.
Its barcode, scanned at the till, adds exactly this variant.
Its stock is kept per warehouse under Inventory, unless Track inventory is off.
Only active variants can be bought; an inactive one is taken out of carts.
A product with at least one variant can be published without a price of its own.
